narrative.overview: A quiet dark ledger. One navy theme, system fonts, flat tonal surfaces and 1px rules. Numbers are tabular, every figure sits next to the window it came from, and colour is spent on verdicts rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme; no light mode.
Flat, tonal, restrained: depth from surface tints and borders.
Verdict colours are a fixed vocabulary.
Status first: verdict pill, one big number, then the evidence line.
Small uppercase labels over large plain numbers.
Touch targets grow to 44px on phones.
Staleness is shown, never hidden: a pill carries the age of the data.

rules.name: The Verdict Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Win, loss, draw and warning each own one triple (ground, line, text). Reuse the triple; never invent a new status colour.

rules.name: The Evidence Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour marks a finding's verdict, not its category. Decorative colour is out.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Numbers that line up in columns or compare across rows use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry no shadow at rest. Overlap is shown with a scrim or an edge, not a glow.

dos: Do take colours, radii and sizes from the :root tokens; add a token before adding a literal.
Do keep 3:1 contrast on field and ghost-button borders and 44px targets on phones.
Do put the observation window beside every figure and show unknown as unknown, never zero.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and keep focus rings visible (2px Link).
Do lead a surface with status, then evidence, then detail; show the age of data when it is not today's.
Do use native elements (dialog, details, button, a) before custom widgets.
Do let the verdict lead: when it says Pocos datos or Estable the figure steps back (16px, muted) so a number never outweighs its evidence.
donts: Don't add a light theme, web fonts or decorative gradients.
Don't add shadows at rest or glows.
Don't put a thick coloured left or right border on a card or note (.loss-note, .hl are legacy).
Don't add streaks, loss framing, confetti or progress bars that exploit completion.
Don't introduce a new status colour outside the Verdict triples.
Don't add inline style attributes (none remain; only dynamic [style.x] bindings); add or extend a named class. The u-* utilities are !important and legacy: use them sparingly.
